acceptanceCriteria: Only literals used as an executed or built path create an edge; a data-only literal does not (test with a fixture of each).
The remaining V1-0991 limits are either fixed or retained as explicit unknowns in the spec.
body:
Filed 2026-10-08 by the orchestrator from batch C (branch claude/batch-c-2026-10-07, base 0c94c66c).

V1-0991 (docs/build-log/2026-10-07-v1-0991-affected-binary-readers.md, Limits): any string literal that names a command directory, even as data (for example internal/mcp/docsbridge), becomes a binary-reader edge, so affected selects that package's tests whenever the command changes. Also noted: an exec consumer's importers are not selected through it, and opt-in legs that take the binary from an environment variable are not declared.
title: corvint affected: a data literal naming a command directory becomes a binary-reader edge and over-selects
